latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of LinkedIn Video Maker skill.
- Upload video clips or images (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generate professional LinkedIn-ready videos with AI-driven editing.
- Supports captions, logo, clean intros, and text overlays; outputs 1080p MP4 files ready for download.
- Automated backend connection, session management, and authentication with free trial credits.
- Simple workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting videos optimized for LinkedIn.
- Error handling and real-time status updates included for a smooth user experience.
